description:
Estimate a New Zealand house's 2026/27 council rates and water charges.

    Use for: 'how much are rates on a $700k house', 'council rates calculator
    nz', 'auckland rates estimate', 'christchurch rates and water', 'what are
    water rates in wellington', 'rates per week nz'.

    ONLY NINE COUNCILS, each for a standard house in the area stated:
    Auckland (Watercare-metered house), Wellington City, Christchurch City,
    Hamilton City, Tauranga City, Dunedin City, Selwyn (Rolleston),
    Waimakariri (Rangiora) and Queenstown Lakes (Queenstown). Any other council
    or town (Kaiapoi, Wanaka, Upper Hutt, Nelson...) returns an error: tell the
    user to use that council's own rates search. Never substitute another
    council's figures.

    FIGURES ARE EACH COUNCIL'S ADOPTED 2026/27 RATES, GST inclusive, with the
    water organisation's 2026/27 prices where it bills water (Watercare, Tiaki
    Wai, IAWAI, Selwyn Water). Usage matters only in Auckland, Tauranga,
    Selwyn, and Christchurch above 900 litres a day (each part of a m3 charged
    as a whole one). A usage of 0 is 0; null is the 170 m3 starting figure.
    For Waimakariri pass land_value, or its urban drainage rate is left out
    (land_value_rate_left_out says so).

    Outside Auckland (a unitary council) regional council rates are NOT
    included. Every answer carries source_url, rating_year and not_included.

    Args:
        capital_value: The property's capital value in dollars.
        council: A council key or name from the page.
        water_usage_m3: Annual water use in cubic metres. Default 170.
        land_value: The property's land value; used only for Waimakariri.

    Returns:
        General rate, UAGC, water, wastewater, stormwater, rubbish, other
        targeted rates, the total yearly, quarterly, monthly and weekly, rates
        as a share of CV, who bills water, the 2026/27 rebate figures, the
        rating year and the council's source.
name: nz_rates_water_calculator
